report.summary: 4 actionable items from 5 reviewed findings: fix Intent.trace_id default, verify budget overshoot in graph_brief._emit, ensure quarantine tasks in render reports, and locate analyse_once shared walk.
risks: Missing file paths: graph_brief.py and Intent class location not provided; assumptions may be wrong.
If analyse_once does not use by_provenance, quarantine tasks may already be correct; effort wasted.
Budget overshoot may not exist if _emit already includes header cost.
todos: Locate Intent dataclass definition and add default for trace_id.
Inspect graph_brief.py lines 283-294 for header cost inclusion.
Inspect render.py analyse_once usage of evaluation aggregates.
Grep for analyse_once callers to confirm shared walk design.

items.title: Fix Intent.trace_id default value contradiction
items.why_now: Breaks all callers that construct Intent without trace_id; must be fixed before any other work.

steps.do: Add default value to trace_id field in Intent dataclass, e.g., trace_id: str = ''
steps.verified_by: python -c "from daedalus.mapping.intent import Intent; i = Intent(); print(i.trace_id)"

items.assumption: Intent class is defined in daedalus/mapping/intent.py; if not, locate actual file.

items.title: Verify budget overshoot in graph_brief._emit
items.why_now: If header cost is added after checking line fit, token budget may be exceeded, causing truncation that ollama cannot repair.

steps.do: Inspect graph_brief.py lines 283-294 to confirm whether header cost is included in budget before deciding to add a line.

items.assumption: graph_brief.py exists at daedalus/mapping/graph_brief.py and contains _emit function with budget logic.

items.title: Ensure quarantine tasks are included in render reports
items.why_now: If analyse_once uses by_provenance results, quarantine tasks will be missing from reach/switch reports even though they are counted.

steps.do: Inspect render.py to see how analyse_once uses evaluation aggregates; check for by_provenance, go/no-go, quarantine references.

items.assumption: render.py exists at daedalus/mapping/render.py and contains analyse_once function.

items.title: Locate analyse_once implementation and shared walk pipeline
items.why_now: The shared data pipeline described in render.py docstring is not visible; need to confirm it exists to avoid design drift.

steps.do: Grep for analyse_once in daedalus/mapping/render.py and recursively in daedalus/ to find its definition and callers.

items.assumption: analyse_once is defined somewhere in daedalus/mapping/render.py or imported from another module.
